title: Radio Heavy Metal - la radio qui te fracasse le crane

lines.l: To take you home
Don't care if every taste
Is leaving me hollow
I'm counting all the ways
I breathe what you sow
You lead and I follow
You lead and I follow
All my colors
Fade to gray
How many more shots can I take, I take
Before I crash out into the waves
How many more deaths can I break, I break
Don't save your roses, don't save your roses for my grave
I hate that I crave your velvet touch
But I wear these chains like I'm yours for taking
I'd do anything just to feel the rush
This bit I'm making only leaves me vacant
Oh my gosh
How many more shots can I take, I take
Before I crash out into the waves
How many more days can I break, I break
Don't save your sins, don't save your sins
